notes: A180654.A180654_general: N! [x^N] sum_{n<=N} log(P_n)^n/(n! n^n) is an integer for P_n(k)=C(n,k)^(e n), e n >= 1 (conj1 p=2, conj2 p>=1, conj3 e n = n). k C(n,k) = n C(n-1,k-1) gives n | coefficients of x(log P_n)'; divided powers of log(P_n)/n stay integer e.g.f.s (theta-induction). Name line has an extra x^n (data follow PARI without it); both readings integral. Outside Lean: reading log P as the series L with L(0)=0, x L' P = x P'.
